# Each write of each act, refused one at a time on a fresh page. A block: the write and the
# answer; the requests that followed it; each run of text that appeared on the page (container,
# innermost element); the sheet; the page's message state; any rejection the page left unhandled.

## Add process (one write)
# writes, in order: POST /api/processes
### POST /api/processes  ←  400 {"error"} (writeError)
    then: nothing

    sheet: open "Add process", status "the Edge refused it" (bad), OK "Create" enabled
    state: no message set
    unhandled rejection: none
    pressed again: POST /api/processes · GET /api/processes · GET /api/processes/5/composer → sheet: closed

    then: nothing

    sheet: open "Add process", status "Server error (500)" (bad), OK "Create" enabled
    state: no message set

### POST /api/processes  ←  session lapsed (303 to /login, 200 text/html, for it and every admin call after)
